title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 2

events.title: SecuX Wallet App 3.0 rolled out for V20
events.description: SecuX documented the full rollout of SecuX Wallet App 3.0 on 2025-03-31 with compatibility for the V20 hardware wallet, device-to-device migration support, refreshed design, broader blockchain support, and a migration path away from the older SecuX Mobile App.

events.title: Cypherock X1 documented Solana integration
events.description: Cypherock published a first-party product update on 2025-01-20 documenting Solana integration with the Cypherock X1, expanding the hardware wallet's supported network capabilities beyond its earlier private-beta launch state.

events.title: SeedSigner 0.8.5 added initial multilingual support
events.description: SeedSigner released version 0.8.5 on 2026-02-04 with its initial localization and multilingual support, Spanish UI support, refreshed UX elements, and basic P2TR address verification, providing a distinct lifecycle milestone before the currently canonical 0.8.7 release.

events.title: Nova Wallet launched Polkadot debit card integration
events.description: Nova Wallet announced on 2025-06-04 that its partnership with Mercuryo and Mastercard had released a Polkadot-powered debit card that could be topped up with DOT directly from Nova Wallet, adding a new spending capability to the mobile wallet lifecycle.

events.title: Core documented gasless transactions for the extension
events.description: Core's first-party support documentation published on 2025-12-16 documented an available gasless transaction flow in which eligible Avalanche C-Chain transactions can receive AVAX for gas and then be submitted automatically. The publication date is used as discovery chronology rather than inferring an earlier launch date.
